lines.zh: 我踩着沙走，耳朵一直转。
lines.en: I pad over the sand, ears turning.

lines.zh: 我的大耳朵比你手掌还宽。
lines.en: My big ears are wider than your palm.
I trot along the dune.
My tail is longer than my body.
I circle the shrub once.
I walk lightly on the hot sand.

lines.zh: 我抬头听了听，又低头走。
lines.en: I listen, then walk on.
I trot over a stone.
I go on with my tail up.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向去闻东西。
lines.en: I change direction to sniff something.

lines.zh: 我的脚印很浅，几乎看不见。
lines.en: My prints are so light they hardly show.
I walk the sand ridge where the wind is weak.
I advance, looking three times a step.
I lie down, ears still moving.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团沙色。
lines.en: I tuck into a ball of sand color.

lines.zh: 我在听沙子下面的声音。
lines.en: I listen to sounds under the sand.
My tail covers my nose.
I am awake, and unwilling to move.
I flick one ear.
I cannot be bothered to look up.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的东西。
lines.en: I slowly chew what is in my mouth.
I am waiting for you to step back.
I start a yawn and stop.
I lie at the burrow mouth, at ease.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵对准了风来的方向。
lines.en: My ears aim upwind.
I curl tighter.

lines.zh: 我数着沙子落在背上的次数。
lines.en: I count the grains landing on my back.
I hover half asleep.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，两只耳朵朝你。
lines.en: I lift my head, both ears on you.
You are far bigger than a fox.
My nose twitches twice.
I lower my tail.
I stare at your boots.
I sit down, carefully.
You crouch, and only then do I come closer.
I keep watching you without moving.
I hear you breathing.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵朝你的方向压平。
lines.en: My ears flatten toward you.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只前爪，又放下。
lines.en: I lift a forepaw, then set it down.

lines.zh: 我在闻你身上别的动物。
lines.en: I smell other animals on you.
You move and I go tense.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地眨了一下眼睛。
lines.en: I blink my eyes slowly.

lines.zh: 我还没有决定要不要跑。
lines.en: I have not decided whether to run.
I yelp and jump.
I ball up, ears flat.
I lick the wound.
I shake all over.
I fix on you, ready to run.
My tail tucks down.

lines.zh: 我疼得耳朵贴平，转身钻进沙里。
lines.en: Ears flat with pain, I turn and dive into the sand.

lines.zh: 嘴里那口食物，我先咽下去再说。
lines.en: That mouthful of food — I swallow it first.

lines.zh: 我闻到味道，耳朵立起来。
lines.en: I smell it and my ears stand up.
I trot over, carefully.
I take it and back off two steps.
I finish it fast and come back for more.
I pin it to the sand and sniff first.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你还有没有。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see if you have more.
This time I do not back off as far.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻摇了一下。
lines.en: My tail gives one small wag.
I sit by your feet and wait.
I carry it into the burrow to hide.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子拱到你的手心。
lines.en: I push my nose into your palm.
You let go and I catch it.
I eat fast, afraid of being robbed.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，嘴里还叼着。
lines.en: I look up with it still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我竖起大耳朵，听你袋里有没有肉干。
lines.en: I prick up my huge ears to hear jerky in your bag.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰你的指节。
lines.en: I tap my nose on your knuckle.
You touch me and I spring up.
I leap away as if startled.
My back hits your leg.
We kick up a patch of sand.
I dart behind you.
My ear brushes your hand.
You step on the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 沙漠的耳朵，比身体还长。
lines.en: Desert ears longer than my body.
I retreat, then look back at you.

lines.zh: 两只狐狸在沙丘上绕圈。
lines.en: Two foxes circle on the dune.
We touch noses.
It chases me a short way.
We lie side by side at the burrow.
I groom behind its ear.
Our tails twine together.
It rests its head on my back.
We listen to the wind outside.

lines.zh: 我们的耳朵朝同一个方向。
lines.en: Our ears point the same way.
We tuck into the burrow together.

lines.zh: 我叼起地上的东西就跑。
lines.en: I snatch it up and run.
I bury it under the sand.
I drag it along in my mouth.
One look and I take it.
I stuff it into the burrow.
I look up at you with it in my mouth.
I set it down and pick it up.
I cannot carry it, so I drag it.
It sways in my mouth.
I freeze, ears forward.
I smell something alive.
I lower myself and creep that way.
My tail goes still.

lines.zh: 我盯住了那个会动的点。
lines.en: I fix on the moving speck.
I am ready to pounce.
I sink my paws into the sand.
I begin to close in slowly.
I have picked that thing over there.
I follow along the sand, low.
I circle to downwind.
I make no sound, one step at a time.
I wait for it to turn.
I am two hops away.
I flatten myself as low as I can.
I change direction with it.
My ears stay forward.
My steps make no sound on sand.
I creep forward half a block.
I pounce and bite its neck.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜里，我的耳朵最灵。
lines.en: Desert night — my ears are keenest.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住兔子的后颈，甩了两下。
lines.en: I bite the rabbit's nape and shake it twice.
I leap in from the side.
It is pressed into the sand.
I shake my head hard.
I leap away and circle.
I miss and land in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙丘上多了一对小耳朵。
lines.en: A pair of small ears appears on the dune.
I poke out of a sand burrow.
There was only wind here before.
I appear beside a cactus.

lines.zh: 你听见沙上很轻的脚步。
lines.en: You hear light steps on sand.

lines.zh: 一个小影子从坡上下来。
lines.en: A small shadow comes down the slope.
I poke half my head out at you.
I start moving on the sand.
I leap aside with singed fur.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，一嘴沙。
lines.en: I tumble down the dune, mouth full of sand.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱刨，耳朵进了水。
lines.en: I paddle wildly, water in my ears.

lines.zh: 爆声把我吓得钻进沙里。
lines.en: The blast sends me diving into the sand.
Hunger leaves me lying flat.

lines.zh: 雷声让我整只贴在地上。
lines.en: The thunder flattens me to the ground.

lines.zh: 下面的沙没有了，我一直掉。
lines.en: The sand is gone; I keep falling.
